run_train_text_to_image_lora: run the LoRA fine-tuning script for Stable Diffusion text-to-image training
run_parse_args: run the argument parser to parse CLI arguments for LoRA text-to-image fine-tuning
run_log_validation: run validation by generating images from a Stable Diffusion pipeline with a given prompt
run_save_model_card: run saving a model card README with example images and metadata for a LoRA fine-tuned model
run_save_model_hook: run the accelerator save hook to checkpoint LoRA weights during distributed training
